scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/server.js --packages=external && esbuild preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/preload.js --packages=external && node scripts/copy-assets.js
scripts.electron:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development ELECTRON_IS_DEV=1 concurrently --kill-others "tsx server.ts" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && cross-env ELECTRON_IS_DEV=1 electron dist-electron/electron/main.js"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:dist: npm run build && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
